summary.text: The Reserve Bank of India held an auction of state government securities on November 9, 2026. The auction raised a total of ₹1,000 crore (1 billion) for Assam, Bihar, and Chhattisgarh. The cut-off price for Assam was ₹97.55, for Bihar it was ₹8.10, and for Chhattisgarh it was ₹900. The securities were reissued at 7.83% for Assam and 7.76% for Bihar.
